reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.review: Not only is it showing its age, not only is it impossible to read the fuel history because the text is too big, but now the one thing I rely on - the mileage calculation - is completely off. Gave up on this after years of use and moved to Fuelly

reviews.title: Love it! But can not replace / delete vehicles
reviews.review: I have been using this app for years now and i love it! Unfortunately now it is time probably to let it go, because there is no way to delete vehicles that i do not own anymore and make space to the new ones

reviews.title: Initial Review
reviews.review: So far, the app is doing the record keeping that I want done. I got rid of gas receipts I have been keeping in my car. This apps is more flexible in terms of inserting and editing information compared to the ones I have seen like the Gas Manager, etc. Gas Manager does not allow you to insert information. To insert old information, you have to delete all information above it. I will be asking refund on the Gas Manager app the I bought.

reviews.title: Works great
reviews.review: No problems with the app. Just wish it would be compatible with the myFuelLoglite version so I can import all the data I had

reviews.title: Please update lite version for iOS 11
reviews.review: Please update MyFuelLogLite for iOS 11. I am unable to access any data from the past 3 years and the file transfer in iTunes won not allow transfer to the pro version.

reviews.title: Not able to launch App with iOS 14.2
reviews.review: This app works well prior the iOS update, it does not launch!!! I lost my 2 years of data entry after reinstalling the app. This developer does not respond to my request tech support.

reviews.title: Works like a charm...
reviews.review: Works fine for me... no crashes. Several setup options for personal preferences, proper fuel/mileage/cost calculations, easy data input, great variety of options for viewing historical data in several helpful aspects. Haven not had to use the maintenance record options yet, so can not speak to its capabilities. Lots of auto manufacturer branding symbols to choose from, option to add vehicle photo, as well as vehicle-specific data. All-around nice & useful app, if you are into basic vehicle operationa

reviews.title: Great so far
reviews.review: Everything it claims to do, it does perfectly. No complaints there. I personally like to measure my $/mile, so that I can calculate the cost of a single trip or estimate how much my travel will cost on a weekly or monthly basis. It would be awesome if you included a feature in the line graph to customize the data on a (blank)-per-(blank) basis, so that I could view my $/gal, $/mi, or mpg. Otherwise it is a great app and i use it every timeI fill up.

reviews.title: Must have to track vehicle expenses
reviews.review: I have been using this app for years now and find it very useful. When I started getting warnings from my iPhone that the app might slow down my phone and might not work in future iOS updates I was very worried, so I am VERY happy the developer has updated the app. Thank you.
